name: Floor General
strength: Creates advantages, controls tempo, and gets teammates clean looks.
tradeoff: Needs finishing and shooting around them.

name: Shot Creator
strength: Breaks down defenders and creates a shot when the offense stalls.
tradeoff: Needs defensive cover and teammates who keep the ball moving.

name: Sharpshooter
strength: Stretches the floor and punishes help with quick-release shooting.
tradeoff: Needs a playmaker to create space and find them.

name: 3-and-D Wing
strength: Spaces the floor and takes tough perimeter defensive assignments.
tradeoff: Less suited to carrying the offense as a primary creator.

name: Two-Way Wing
strength: Connects the offense and brings versatile perimeter defense.
tradeoff: A balanced role rather than a specialist who dominates one skill.

name: Slasher
strength: Attacks gaps and runs the floor to pressure the rim.
tradeoff: Needs spacing; a crowded paint limits driving lanes.

name: Rim Protector
strength: Anchors the paint and supports a defense-first lineup.
tradeoff: Pair with perimeter shooting to keep the floor open.

name: Glass Cleaner
strength: A hustle-big role built around athleticism and interior defense.
tradeoff: Needs guards to create offense; rebounding is a projected role, not a sourced stat.

name: Stretch Big
strength: Pulls a defender away from the rim and opens driving lanes.
tradeoff: Pair with an interior defender against stronger paint teams.
